projection_id = 'en-019d96e2-5737-7e01-82b1-99d18f752595'
model_id_input = 'en-019d92cd-41e7-7aa0-8436-e0532786bfcf'
projection = temper.get('Projections', projection_id)
fields = projection.get('fields', {})
model_id = fields.get('foresight_model_id', model_id_input)
max_steps_raw = fields.get('max_steps', '2')
if isinstance(max_steps_raw, int):
    max_steps = max_steps_raw
else:
    try:
        max_steps = int(max_steps_raw)
    except:
        max_steps = 2
step_schedule_raw = fields.get('step_schedule', '[90, 365]')
probe_config_raw = fields.get('probe_config', '[]')
horizon = fields.get('horizon', '1 year')

def parse_simple_json_array(raw):
    if isinstance(raw, list):
        return raw
    s = str(raw).strip()
    if s == '':
        return []
    try:
        return eval(s)
    except:
        return []

step_schedule = parse_simple_json_array(step_schedule_raw)
probe_config = parse_simple_json_array(probe_config_raw)
fmodel = temper.get('ForesightModels', model_id)
fm_fields = fmodel.get('fields', {})
fm_name = fm_fields.get('name', 'Unknown Model')
kg_file_id = fm_fields.get('model_snapshot_file_id', '')
kg_content = ''
kg_path = ''
kg_ws_id = ''
if kg_file_id != '':
    kg_file = temper.get('Files', kg_file_id)
    kgf = kg_file.get('fields', {})
    kg_ws_id = kgf.get('WorkspaceId', '')
    kg_path = kgf.get('Path', '')
    if kg_path != '':
        if kg_ws_id != '':
            kg_content = temper.read(kg_path, {'workspace_id': kg_ws_id})
        else:
            kg_content = temper.read(kg_path)
my_session = temper.get('Sessions', temper.get_session_id())
my_fields = my_session.get('fields', {})
my_model = my_fields.get('model', 'gpt-5.4')
my_provider = my_fields.get('provider', 'openai_codex')
my_session_id = temper.get_session_id()
agent_id = temper.get_agent_id()
summary = {
    'model_id': model_id,
    'max_steps': max_steps,
    'step_schedule': step_schedule,
    'probe_count': len(probe_config),
    'horizon': horizon,
    'fm_name': fm_name,
    'kg_file_id': kg_file_id,
    'kg_path': kg_path,
    'kg_ws_id': kg_ws_id,
    'kg_len': len(kg_content) if isinstance(kg_content, str) else 0,
    'my_model': my_model,
    'my_provider': my_provider,
    'session_id': my_session_id,
    'agent_id': agent_id
}
summary
